preconditions.description: The input integer x must be an odd number between 3 and 999,999 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The final output must contain the number 1 on the blackboard.
The number of operations q must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= num <= 5e18 for num in numbers)
postconditions.description: All numbers written on the blackboard must be within the range [0, 5e18].

postconditions.expression: any(operation in ['a + b', 'a ^ b'] for operation in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must be either a sum or a bitwise XOR operation.
